title: 第21章 奉天圣女第22章 公主 是我错了
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
联姻！
白骨夫人此话一出，夜洐神色不变。
杀人寇跟血魔反倒怒了。
夜洐所经历一切，不是什么秘密，他们早已知道。
知道夜洐所承受的一切痛苦，来自姜云璃公主，来自神枪侯世子凌云飞，以及凌青璇。
“姜云璃跟凌云飞？这等货色的男人，你也瞧得上，胃口真够好的。”夜洐只感觉到恶心。
他对姜云璃早就没有任何男女想法。
她只是敌人。
但敌人如此丑陋。
顿感无趣。
“大人，不是姜云璃跟凌云飞，是凌云飞跟晋王府的姜云华郡主联姻。”白骨夫人知道大家误会了，说出更详细的情报。
整个晋王府，不止一位世子，也不止一位郡主。
只是姜云璃的名气太大，大到提到晋王府，首先想到的都是她。
姜云华，夜洐隐约记得，曾经来隐龙城找过她的姐姐姜云璃。
她拥有贵女的气质，骄傲！
夜洐远远看过一眼。
处于礼貌，本想上前打招呼，但刚迈步，她就转身离开了，不知是巧合，还是不愿与夜洐认识。
既然别人不愿，夜洐也停下脚步。
对她印象不深，反倒是跟她一同前来的那个青年，夜洐记忆很深。
看来又是一个舔狗，败给了利益联姻。

“实权王爷与边关大将联姻，强强联合，这就是姜云璃你所说的为了天下苍生，为了天下太平？虚伪到极致的女人。”
夜洐更感到恶心。
明明很清楚，凌云飞可是淫贼，是变态。
还要联姻。
除了是利益联姻，还能是什么？难道是爱情。
“联姻时间。”夜洐不由询问。
都是朋友。
不准备礼物，就失礼了。
“联姻时间，是冬月十八。”
夜洐估算一下时间，不到三月的时间。
很好，时间很充裕，有时间准备盛大的礼物。
“姜云璃消息有多少？”
“有关她在北洲城的传闻，简直铺天盖地，无人可与之匹敌。”白骨夫人眼中出现深深的忌惮：“传闻她加入了奉天教，甚至传闻她是奉天教圣女。”
content_en:
Marriage!
As soon as Madam Bai Gu said these words, Ye Huo's expression did not change.
The murderer and the blood demon were angry.
What Ye Hui went through was not a secret, they already knew it.
Knowing that all the pain Ye Hui endured came from Princess Jiang Yunli, the Master Spear Prince Ling Yunfei, and Ling Qingxuan.
"Jiang Yunli and Ling Yunfei? You can take a fancy to men like these. They have really good appetites." Ye Wei only felt sick.
He has long had no thoughts about Jiang Yunli as a man or woman.
She is just the enemy.
But the enemy is so ugly.
Feeling bored.
"Sir, it's not Jiang Yunli and Ling Yunfei who are getting married, it's Ling Yunfei marrying Princess Jiang Yunhua of the Jin Palace." Madam Bai Gu knew that everyone had misunderstood and gave more detailed information.
In the entire Jin Palace, there is more than one prince and more than one princess.
It's just that Jiang Yunli's reputation is so great that when mentioning Prince Jin's Mansion, she is the first thing that comes to mind.
Jiang Yunhua, Ye Hao vaguely remembered, once came to Hidden Dragon City to look for her sister Jiang Yunli.
She has the temperament of a noble lady and is proud!
Ye Tao glanced at it from a distance.
Out of politeness, she wanted to step forward to say hello, but as soon as she took a step, she turned and left. I don't know if it was a coincidence, or she didn't want to get to know Ye Wei.
Since others were unwilling, Ye Hui also stopped.
She didn't have a deep impression on her, but the young man who came with her had a deep memory for Ye Wei.
It seems that he is another licker who lost to the marriage of interests.
"The powerful prince marries the border general and joins forces. Is this what Jiang Yunli said for the common people and peace of the world? A woman who is extremely hypocritical."
Ye Qi felt even more nauseous.
It is obvious that Ling Yunfei is a pervert and a pervert.
Also get married.
Besides a marriage of interests, what else could it be? Could it be love.
"Marriage time." Ye Hao couldn't help but ask.
All are friends.
It would be rude not to prepare a gift.
"The time of marriage is the eighteenth day of the winter lunar month."
Ye Zhi estimated the time, it would be less than three months.
Very good, there is plenty of time to prepare a grand gift.
"How much news is there about Jiang Yunli?"
"The rumors about her in Beizhou City are overwhelming, and no one can match them." Madam Baigu showed deep fear in her eyes: "It is rumored that she has joined the Fengtian Sect, and there are even rumors that she is a saint of the Fengtian Sect."
